summary.zh: 招募与成员管理系统负责学生候选池、手动邀请、贿赂、成员分组、核心成员和职位调整。
summary.en: The recruitment and member management system handles student candidates, invitations, bribery, member grouping, core members, and role assignment.

items.zh: 招募菜单按年级列出尚未加入组织的学生。
items.en: The recruitment menu lists students who have not joined the organization by grade.

items.zh: 候选学生拥有姓名、年级、性格、派系、状态、信任度和压力等信息。
items.en: Candidates have information such as name, grade, personality, faction, state, trust, and pressure.

items.zh: 玩家可以查看学生详情，再决定是否贿赂或邀请。
items.en: The player can inspect student details before deciding whether to bribe or invite.

items.zh: 邀请成功率主要受学生信任度影响。
items.en: Invitation success is mainly affected by the student's trust.

items.zh: 信任过低的学生无法被直接邀请。
items.en: Students with very low trust cannot be directly invited.

items.zh: 贿赂可以提高信任，但对管理层支持者使用时存在暴露风险。
items.en: Bribery can raise trust, but using it on faculty supporters risks exposure.

items.zh: 成员菜单分为核心成员和普通成员。
items.en: The member menu separates core members from regular members.

items.zh: 玩家可以查看成员详情、所属小队、压力、信任和能力。
items.en: The player can inspect member details, squad assignment, pressure, trust, and abilities.

items.zh: 成员职位可调整为副主席、宣传部长、情报部长、后勤部长或成员。
items.en: Member roles can be assigned as vice president, propaganda minister, intelligence minister, logistics minister, or member.

items.zh: 特殊核心角色有额外限制，避免玩家误删关键人物。
items.en: Special core roles have extra restrictions to prevent accidental removal of key characters.
